variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 12.7x55mm VPS
variants.info: Load your VKS with 12.7x55mm VPS armor piercing rounds: giving it significantly increased penetration, but halves your limb kill range while also lowering bullet speed and minimum damage due to overpenetration!
